tbesh_html:
1) formlessness, confusion, unreality, emptiness
1a) formlessness (of primeval earth)
1a1) nothingness, empty space
1b) that which is empty or unreal (of idols) (fig)
1c) wasteland, wilderness (of solitary places)
1d) place of chaos
1e) vanity

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a desolation (of surface), i.e. desert; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain
strongs_1890.derivation: from an unused root meaning to lie waste;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: confusion, empty place, without form, nothing, (thing of) nought, vain, vanity, waste, wilderness.
